subject.title: [Bug]: macOS onboarding rejects a logged-in Codex CLI on fresh installs

question: Should maintainers land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102637 as the canonical fix for this protected macOS Codex onboarding blocker?
rationale: The root cause is source-reproducible, but the issue is protected and the active fix touches setup inference, provider auth routing, plugin install state, and macOS first-run UX.

options.title: Review and land the open PR
options.body: Use the open closing PR as the canonical repair path after its current review blocker and compatibility proof are acceptable.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking for the Codex runtime-bootstrap repair to be separated from broader onboarding/UI hardening if needed.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PR only if maintainers decide fresh macOS onboarding should not reuse logged-in Codex CLI credentials this way.

recommendation.title: Review and land the open PR
recommendation.body: Use the open closing PR as the canonical repair path after its current review blocker and compatibility proof are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the report, is assigned, and sponsors the linked candidate fix.
